name.ja: 2次元Poisson：CG・多重格子とP1 FEM

scope.ja: 単位正方形のsin(πx)sin(πy)を参照し、CG/MGは15/31/63内部点、P1 FEMは4/8/16分割で細分化。FDの最大誤差と真の残差、FEMの要素内L2誤差とH1半ノルムを独立に評価する。
scope.en: Reference sin(πx)sin(πy) on the unit square; refine CG/MG through 15/31/63 interior nodes and P1 FEM through 4/8/16 subdivisions. Independently evaluate FD maximum errors/true residuals and FEM element-interior L2/H1-seminorm errors.

scope.en: Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution.

title.ja: Nohの冷たい流入衝撃波：平面・円筒・球対称
title.en: Noh cold-inflow shock: planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry

assumptions.ja: 理想気体Euler、γ=5/3、初期密度1・内向き速度1・圧力0。r∈[0,1]、t=0.6。平面(d=1)・円筒半径対称(d=2)・球半径対称(d=3)の有限体積計算で、圧力の床は使いません。球のカラー図は1次元半径データの中心断面で、Cartesianの3次元計算ではありません。 別の実2D Cartesian版では[-.5,.5]²の32²/64²/128²格子、2成分運動量と両方向流束を使い、半径還元は行いません。密度参照は衝撃円で分割した64/128点の求積セル平均です。
assumptions.en: Ideal-gas Euler, gamma=5/3, rho0=1, inward speed 1, p0=0; r in [0,1], t=0.6. Planar (d=1), cylindrical-radial (d=2) and spherical-radial (d=3) finite-volume calculations without a pressure floor. The spherical color picture is a central section of one-dimensional radial data, not a Cartesian three-dimensional computation. A separate full-square2D Cartesian calculation uses [-.5,.5]^2 with32²/64²/128² cells, both momenta and no radial reduction. Its density-cell reference is shock-split quadrature, checked at orders64/128.

Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity.

title.ja: Sedov–Taylorの点爆発：エネルギー正規化した球対称自己相似解
title.en: Sedov–Taylor point blast: energy-normalized spherical similarity solution

assumptions.ja: 理想気体Eulerの球半径対称、γ=5/3、周囲密度1・圧力0、爆発エネルギー1、r∈[0,1]、t=0.05。自己相似参照は瞬間的な理想点源を表しますが、有限体積計算は半径0.03の内部へ投入し、同じ最細格子で半径0.015も比較します。参照は相似ODEの数値積分、小さな中心域の正則漸近形、衝撃位置で分割する球殻求積を含む半解析解であり、閉形式の厳密セル平均ではありません。ギャラリー図は1次元球半径データの中心断面で、2D Cartesian計算ではありません。固定投入半径での誤差には点源とのモデル差が含まれ、その傾きは純粋な空間収束次数ではなく、投入半径の変更も感度診断に留まります。
assumptions.en: Ideal-gas Euler in spherical radial symmetry, gamma=5/3, ambient rho0=1 and p0=0, explosion energy E0=1, r in [0,1], t=0.05. The similarity reference describes ideal instantaneous point deposition. Finite-volume runs instead deposit energy inside radius 0.03, with a paired radius-0.015 sensitivity calculation. The reference uses a numerical similarity-ODE integration, a tiny-core regular asymptote and split shell quadrature; it is semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. The gallery picture is a central section of one-dimensional spherical-radial data, not a two-dimensional Cartesian computation. Fixed-radius errors include point-source model discrepancy, so their refinement slope is not a pure spatial order; the paired-radius calculation is only a sensitivity diagnostic.

Three grids of128/256/512 radial cells measure differences from a point-blast similarity reference and conservation budgets. The picture is a section display of1D spherical data, not a2D Cartesian calculation.

note.ja: エネルギー正規化した球対称の自己相似参照。相似ODEの数値積分・球殻平均の求積を含む半解析解で、閉形式の厳密セル平均とは区別します。有限半径の投入初期値は理想点爆発の特異初期値と一致しません。 固定した有限の投入半径で点源の自己相似参照と比べるため、誤差曲線には投入モデルの差も含まれ、純粋な空間精度の収束次数ではありません。同じ最細格子で投入半径を変える比較は感度診断であり、連続極限の投入誤差とPDE離散化誤差を完全に分離する検証ではありません。
note.en: An energy-normalized spherical similarity reference. Numerical integration of similarity ODEs and shell quadrature make this semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. Finite-radius deposition is distinct from the singular ideal point-blast initial data. At fixed finite deposition radius, comparison with the point-source similarity reference includes deposition-model discrepancy; its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order. Changing deposition radius on the same finest grid is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a complete separation of continuum deposition and PDE-discretization errors.

title.ja: Double Mach反射：保存済み独立有限格子数値参照
title.en: Double Mach reflection: saved independent finite-grid numerical reference

assumptions.ja: 領域[0,4]×[0,1]の2次元理想気体Euler、γ=1.4、Mach10・角度60度の入射衝撃波、初期の衝撃脚x=1/6、最終時刻T=.2。保存参照は別実装の非分割primitive MUSCL/HLL/Heun有限体積法（勾配制限はgeneralized minmodのθ=1.5、MC型であり標準MCのθ=2とは異なる）で、256×64と512×128セルです。主計算とHLLという流束族・Heun時間積分の数式を共有しますが、空間再構成と実装は別です。保存量を保つ制限で比較用セル平均を得ます。不変のRKDG2Dキットで以前に実行したソース・配列・記録を再利用し、今回の参照PDE・Athena・LAVAの新規実行ではありません。参照の格子差も有限分解能の感度指標で、厳密な誤差上界ではありません。厳密2D解でも細いwall jet・渦構造の収束検証でもありません。 入射不連続面の初期化はセル中心での状態判定であり、衝撃面で切られたセルの厳密平均からの初期化ではありません。
assumptions.en: Two-dimensional ideal-gas Euler flow on [0,4] × [0,1], with gamma = 1.4, a Mach-10 incident shock at 60 degrees, initial shock foot x = 1/6 and final time T = 0.2. The saved reference uses a separately written, unsplit primitive MUSCL/HLL/Heun finite-volume code on 256 × 64 and 512 × 128 cells. Its generalized-minmod slope parameter is theta = 1.5 (MC-type, rather than canonical MC with theta = 2). The primary and reference codes share the HLL flux family and Heun time-integration equations, while their spatial reconstruction and implementations are separate. Conservative restriction produces comparison cell means. Previously executed source, data and receipts are reused from the immutable RKDG2D kit; no reference PDE, Athena or LAVA was executed anew for this addition. Reference grid differences indicate finite-resolution sensitivity, not rigorous error bounds. This is not an analytic 2D solution or a convergence test for the thin wall jet and vortex pattern. The incident discontinuity is classified at cell centers, rather than initialized from exact cut-cell averages.

title.ja: Mach 3前向きステップ：独立C++有限格子数値参照
title.en: Mach-3 forward-facing step: independent C++ finite-grid numerical reference

assumptions.ja: γ=1.4の2次元Euler流れ。[0,3]×[0,1]のうちx≥.6,y<.2は固体とし、初期・入口の(ρ,u,v,p)=(1.4,3,0,1)、上下と段差は滑り壁、右端はゼロ勾配、T=4です。参照は独立したC++17実装のprimitive MUSCL（一般化minmod θ1.5）/Davis HLL/HeunをCFL=.3、240×80・480×160で新規実行しました。境界に接する法線方向の傾きはゼロにし、再構築の傾き再調整はセル平均を変えません。Python主計算は区分定数HLL/Heunで、流束族・時間積分式は共有しますが実装と空間再構築は別です。角のエントロピー/エンタルピー補正、状態floor、刻み再試行はありません。角の数値エントロピー層が下流へ移流され得る無補正条件であり、補正付き原著PPM像の再現とは区別します。固体を除いた保存量を保守的に制限してから圧力を算出し、参照格子差・保存収支・局所診断を残します。有限格子の数値参照であり、厳密2次元解、誤差上界、細いすべり線や巻き上がりの収束証明ではありません。
assumptions.en: Two-dimensional ideal-gas Euler flow with gamma=1.4 in [0,3]×[0,1] excluding the solid step x>=.6,y<.2. Uniform initial/inflow primitive state (rho,u,v,p)=(1.4,3,0,1), reflecting slip channel/step walls, right zero-gradient outflow and T=4. The reference is a separately written C++17 unsplit finite-volume implementation with primitive MUSCL generalized minmod(theta=1.5), Davis HLL flux and Heun/SSPRK2 at CFL=.3 on 240×80 and480×160 cells. Normal slopes touching walls/exterior boundaries are zero; reconstructed primitive slopes may be rescaled without altering cell means. The primary Python calculation uses piecewise-constant HLL plus Heun; flux family/time equations are shared, while implementation and spatial reconstruction are separate. No Woodward–Colella corner entropy/enthalpy reset, state floors or time-step retries are used. The uncorrected corner can produce an entropy layer that affects the downstream reflected shock/Mach stem. This is a finite-grid numerical reference, not an exact solution, rigorous error bound, replication of corner-corrected original PPM figures, or proof that fine slip lines/vortices are resolved.

title.ja: 等エントロピー渦：低Mach比較に用いるEuler解析場
title.en: Isentropic vortex: analytic Euler field for low-Mach comparisons

assumptions.ja: 全平面Eulerの移動等エントロピー渦を、γ=1.4、β=3、背景密度1、背景速度U=(1,.5)で定義します。背景Mach数Mに対してp∞=1.25/(1.4M²)とし、θ=1−(γ−1)β²exp(1−r²)/(8γπ²p∞)、ρ=θ^(1/(γ−1))、p=p∞θ^(γ/(γ−1))です。Uとともに動く座標を[-10,10]²へ折り返します。解析式は全平面の厳密なEuler解ですが、有限周期箱の継ぎ目にはゼロでないGaussianの裾があり、滑らかな周期トーラスの厳密解とは区別します。4保存量のセル平均をGauss8で求積しGauss16と照合した後、圧力・速度へ変換します。閉形式の厳密セル平均やprimitive変数の平均ではありません。低Mach固定例はM=.1/.01、T=.1。p∞=1で従来KEEPの場へ戻ります。
assumptions.en: The translating whole-plane ideal-gas Euler vortex uses gamma=1.4, beta=3, far-field density1 and background velocity U=(1,.5). For background Mach number M, p_inf=1.25/(1.4*M^2); theta=1-(gamma-1)*beta^2*exp(1-r^2)/(8*gamma*pi^2*p_inf), rho=theta^(1/(gamma-1)), p=p_inf*theta^(gamma/(gamma-1)). Coordinates move with U and are wrapped in [-10,10]^2. The whole-plane field is analytic; the finite minimum-image periodic field retains nonzero Gaussian seam tails and is not a globally exact smooth torus solution. Tensor Gauss8 cell means of all conserved variables are checked against Gauss16, then primitive pressure and velocity are recovered from those means. These are numerical cell quadratures, not closed-form exact cell averages or means of primitive variables. The low-Mach fixed runs use M=.1/.01 and T=.1; the historical KEEP case is recovered by p_inf=1.

title.en: Guderley converging shock: eigenvalue and spherical semi-analytic reference

assumptions.ja: 理想気体Eulerの球半径対称、γ=1.4、未衝撃上流ρ0=1,u=p=0。Lazarus時間t∈[-1,-.85]、r∈[0,.75]、R_s(t)=.6(-t)^α、α=1/λです。原点収束t=0は区間外で、初期場の外側には衝撃後の相似状態があります。λは固定ExactPackの固有値探索と元stateの8点照合で求めた資格確認済みの保存値を通常追試で再利用し、相似ODE・Gauss16/32球殻求積・Euler計算は再実行します。固有値探索と元ソース点照合の再生成は別の明示コマンドです。衝撃で積分を分けた保存量の体積平均からpを求め、原始圧力の平均と区別します。閉形式の厳密セル平均や独立に実装した相似解とは呼びません。図は1D球半径結果の2D子午面表示で、2D Cartesianや反射後の計算ではありません。
assumptions.en: Ideal-gas Euler in spherical radial symmetry, gamma=1.4, with unshocked upstream rho0=1, u=p=0. Lazarus time t in [-1,-0.85] excludes collapse at 0; r in [0,0.75], Rs(t)=0.6*(-t)^alpha and alpha=1/lambda. The initial field already contains the shocked outer similarity state. Lambda was computed and qualified using pinned ExactPack eigenvalue shooting and eight original-state probes. Routine replay reuses that recorded lambda and freshly integrates the same pinned pre-collapse similarity ODE. Full eigenvalue and original-probe regeneration is a separate explicit command. Shells are split at the shock and conserved states are Gauss16 volume averaged, checked against Gauss32; pressure is p(Ubar). This is a dense-output adapter to ExactPack, not closed-form exact cell means or an independent similarity implementation. The figure maps 1D spherical-radial data onto a 2D meridional section, not 2D Cartesian or post-collapse evolution.

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形の2次元スカラー輸送です。速度(.5−y,x−.5)、角速度1、周期2π、中心(.5,.75)・半径.15の円盤から.475<x<.525かつy<.85のスロットを除き、内部1・外部0とします。公式Firedrake例の正規化した切り欠き円盤だけを取り出した変種で、bell・cone・背景値1・DG・流入境界は再現しません。周期有限体積の対向面では法線速度が一致します。連続解の台は境界から離れており、数値的な裾は別に測ります。参照は剛体回転の逆特性と円盤・多角形の解析的な面積積分によるセル平均で、点値を並べた画像や別PDE計算の細格子解ではありません。一回転後の連続形状への帰還と、位置・初期角度を変えた固定診断を区別します。

The baseline indicator is one inside the disk of radius 0.15 centered at (0.5,0.75), excluding 0.475<x<0.525 and y<0.85, and zero outside. This isolates the normalized slotted-cylinder component described in the official Firedrake setup; its bell, cone, background 1, DG discretization and inflow boundary are not copied. Periodic finite-volume normal velocities match on opposite faces; the compact exact body stays away from the boundary, while numerical tails are measured. Exact rigid characteristics and analytic disk/polygon intersection areas define the reference cell means, not rasterized point samples or a second numerical PDE solution. A full turn returns to the initial continuum shape; rotated/shifted variants are separate fixed diagnostics.

title.ja: WENO臨界点：多項式セル平均と解析的周期輸送
title.en: WENO critical points: polynomial cell means and analytic periodic transport

assumptions.ja: 局所参照はx=0を中心とする5セルの解析平均からh/2を評価する多項式です。通常・一次・二次臨界の3形、h=1/64…1/512を区別します。実際の周期輸送参照は[0,1]、速度1、T1、q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx)のFourier積分セル平均で、別のGauss12点関数求積と照合します。局所多項式と輸送の初期形は異なり、点値や別PDE計算の参照ではありません。
assumptions.en: Local references integrate polynomials over five cells centered around x=0 and evaluate at h/2. Regular, first-critical and second-critical profiles use h=1/64…1/512. The actual periodic-transport reference is the Fourier-integrated cell mean of q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx) on[0,1], speed1,T1, checked independently by Gauss12 point-function quadrature. Local polynomials differ from the evolved profile; neither point samples nor another PDE calculation are substituted for cell means.

title.ja: 静止湖：表現した床の上の湿潤・露出平衡
title.en: Lake at rest: wet and emerged equilibrium over represented bed

assumptions.ja: g9.81、[0,25]m、200セル。8<x<12の放物線床z=.2−.05(x−10)²をセルごとにGauss8で平均し、h_i=max(η₀−z_i,0)、q_i=0、η₀=.5/.1mを初期化します。静水再構成が保つのはこの表現した区分定数床の平衡であり、連続床上の水深平均をそのまま使う別問題ではありません。
assumptions.en: Use g9.81,[0,25]m and200cells. Represent z=.2−.05(x−10)² on8<x<12 by split Gauss8 cell means, initializing h_i=max(eta0−z_i,0),q_i0 with eta0=.5/.1m. Hydrostatic reconstruction preserves equilibrium over this represented piecewise-constant bed; this differs from directly averaging depth over the continuous bed.

assumptions.ja: g9.81、[0,25]m、同じ放物線床、流量q4.42m²/s、下流h2m。h+z+q²/(2gh²)=2+q²/(8g)の非射流根を別の二分法で求め、セル平均求積を比較します。100/200/400セルのPDE計算は定常参照から初期化してt2まで進め、SWASHESの静止状態からの過渡計算そのものは再現しません。

PDE runs on100/200/400cells start from the steady reference and advance to t2; they do not reproduce the original rest-to-steady transient.

name.ja: 乾いた河床のダム破壊：実際のwetting/drying
name.en: Dry-bed dam break: actual wetting and dry states

scope.ja: 右半分を厳密にh=q=0として開始する浅水方程式を解き、実際の乾湿前線の進行と保存をRitter解析解と比較します。
scope.en: Start the right half at exactly h=q=0 and compare wetting-front advance, conservation and conservative errors with the Ritter analytic solution.

note.ja: 前線診断はセル平均の.001m等深線で、厳密な支持端を別に保存します。非負性は固定実行の実測です。初期乾セルの濡れを検査し、後退汀線・周期的な再乾燥、実地洪水、摩擦や地形上の移動前線は検証しません。 初回100/200/400セル・[−5,5]mでは28検査と105/109判定が合格し、乾セル残存3判定と前線誤差.3960>.25mが不合格でした。元の全記録を保持し、許容条件を変えず領域・格子を細分化しました。 領域・格子だけを変えた第2回は微小な裾のbinary64 underflowで停止しました。第3回は同じHLL更新の水量packetによる代数的評価を導入し、元の28検査に3検査を追加します。
note.en: The .001m mean-depth contour differs from the analytic support edge, which is reported separately. These fixed runs test wetting of initially dry cells. Retreating shorelines, re-drying cycles, real floods, friction and moving fronts over topography are outside scope. The initial100/200/400-cell [-5,5]m attempt passed28 tests and105/109 gates; three retained-dry-cell gates and the .3960m>.25m contour error failed. All original records remain archived; revision2 enlarges/refines the input without changing acceptance. Revision2 then stopped on a binary64 subnormal-tail dry-momentum artifact. Revision3 factors the same HLL update into water packets and adds three regression/equivalence tests; the original28 remain unchanged.

cases.formula: psi*=8 f(x)f(y),f(z)=z²(1−z)²; s=u*omega*_x+v*omega*_y−nu*Delta omega*. Separate: p_op=x²+y²+sin(pi*x)sin(pi*y).

title.ja: 壁面製造解：多項式速度と独立した圧力演算子
title.en: Wall manufactured solution: polynomial velocity and separate pressure operator

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形・ν.01・滑りなし、ψ*=8x²(1−x)²y²(1−y)²、u*=ψ*y、v*=−ψ*x、ω*=−Δψ*。連続の渦度式からs=u*ω*x+v*ω*y−νΔω*を構成し、独立の係数行列微分と照合します。PDE計算の壁渦度はキャビティと同じThom式で、厳密値を注入しません。p_op=x²+y²+sinπx sinπyの非零Dirichlet Poisson・勾配は別の演算子問題で、流れに結合した圧力やキャビティ圧力ではありません。
assumptions.en: Unit square,viscosity.01,no-slip,psi*=8x²(1−x)²y²(1−y)²,u*=psi*_y,v*=−psi*_x,omega*=−Delta psi*. Construct s=u*omega*_x+v*omega*_y−nu*Delta omega* from the continuous vorticity PDE, qualified by independent tensor-coefficient differentiation. PDE wall vorticity uses the same Thom closure as the cavity without exact injection. Nonzero-Dirichlet Poisson/gradient for p_op=x²+y²+sin(pi*x)sin(pi*y) is a separate operator problem, not coupled flow or cavity pressure.

scope.en: Apply analytic forcing to the same wall-bounded2D solver, measuring grid convergence of velocity/streamfunction and actual wall-vorticity/shear errors. A separate nonzero-Dirichlet manufactured pressure verifies Poisson and boundary-gradient operators.

note.ja: Thomの壁渦度局所打切りは一次で、壁剪断の二次精度は主張せず観測次数を示します。流れ関数の発展では圧力を消去するためゲージは該当しません。圧力診断は独立した演算子製造問題であり、キャビティの圧力・応力境界やMAC射影の検証ではありません。多項式の別微分は独立な流体ソルバーとの比較とは区別します。
note.en: Thom wall vorticity has first-order local truncation; publish observed shear rates without promising second order. Pressure is eliminated from streamfunction evolution, so a pressure gauge is inapplicable. The separate operator MMS does not verify cavity pressure, traction boundaries or MAC projection. Independent polynomial differentiation is distinct from comparison with an independent flow solver.

title.ja: レベルセット円の2D平行移動：界面・面積・再初期化：解析的符号付き距離参照
title.en: 2D level-set circle translation: interface, area and redistancing: analytic signed-distance reference

assumptions.ja: 全て無次元、領域[0,1]²、内部φ<0。与えた非圧縮の剛体運動だけを解き、円は境界から離れます。外側2層のゴースト値は各RK段階で解析解を指定します。周期境界ではなく、内部のφは数値更新します。出力時刻0/.25/.5/.75/1、物理Courant数max(|u|+|v|)Δt/Δx≤.35。
assumptions.en: All quantities are nondimensional on[0,1]², with phi<0 inside. The prescribed divergence-free rigid motion keeps the circle away from the boundary. Two exterior ghost layers receive analytic data at each RK stage; this is not a periodic boundary. Every interior value is numerically advanced. Observe0/.25/.5/.75/1; max(|u|+|v|)dt/dx<=.35.

assumptions.ja: c=1、γ=5/3、ρ=1、p=.1、左右v=±.3、B=0。区間[0,1]、初期不連続x=.5、t=.3、96/192/384セル。衝撃波が端へ届く前の外挿境界です。Taub断熱式と相対速度式の圧力根から静止した同一星状態と衝撃波速度を求め、保存変数の区分一定厳密場をセル積分します。接触面は退化し、一般三波Riemannソルバーではありません。
assumptions.en: c=1,gamma5/3,rho1,p.1,opposite normal v±.3,B0. Domain[0,1], initial jump .5,t=.3,96/192/384 cells. Constant extrapolation boundaries before shocks reach endpoints. Solve the pressure root from Taub adiabat and relative-velocity relations for the identical resting star states and shock speeds, then integrate the piecewise-constant exact conserved field over cells. The contact degenerates; this is not a general three-wave Riemann solver.

assumptions.ja: 平坦時空、c=4π=1、γ=4/3、ρ=p=Bx=η=1、vx=0の厳密族。原著2π周期を単位区間へ写し、64/128/256セル、周期境界、t=1/vA。Bxは1次元で固定します。非線形Alfvén速度の閉じた式を使い、点の原始変数から独立なストレステンソルで保存量と流束を作り、Gauss積分と複素段階PDE残差で確認します。原著の2π周期を単位区間へ移しています。

Use the closed nonlinear Alfven-speed formula. Independently form conserved quantities/fluxes from point primitives through the stress tensor; qualify Gauss integration and complex-step PDE residuals. Rescale the original2pi period to the unit interval.

title.ja: SEIR保存則と初期線形化
title.en: SEIR conservation and initial linearization

assumptions.en: Use a closed population S+E+I+R=1 with β=0.6, σ=0.3 and γ=0.2. For η=10⁻⁴ or 5×10⁻⁵, start from (1−2η,η,η,0) and evolve to t=20. There are no births, deaths or external inflows.

cases.reference_scope: Separate full-ODE integration error, population conservation and nonnegativity through t=20 from linearization-model error at 201 reference points on 0≤t≤1. Qualify scaled Jacobians, Radau/BDF agreement with an η² margin and the analytic full matrix exponential independently. These fixed-coefficient calculations compare two small initial infection levels. The early linearization is not an exact solution through t=20, and a single dominant mode does not replace the two-mode solution. No epidemic forecast, statistical coverage or arbitrary-population guarantee is claimed.
